answer_4.quote: Each instance was annotated by three professional annotators with university education and fluent English language skills, one being a native English speaker.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators were trained on 200 instances from each dataset, with two feedback sessions, before annotating the main batch. The annotations were done using the brat tool.
